Item 6b Public Comment

October 3, 2022

City of Inglewood
1 Manchester Boulevard
Inglewood, CA 90301

Re: Proposed 939 West Manchester Boulevard Housing Development.

Dear Planning Commission and City Attorney:

The California Renters Legal Advocacy and Education Fund (CaRLA) submits this letter to
inform the Inglewood Planning Commission that they have an obligation to abide by all
relevant state housing laws when evaluating the proposed 939 West Manchester Boulevard
housing development. The Housing Accountability Act (GOV 65589.5) requires approval of
zoning and general plan compliant projects unless findings can be made regarding specific,
objective, written health and safety hazards.

As you are well aware, California remains in the throes of a statewide crisis-level housing
shortage. New housing such as this is a public benefit; it will bring increased tax revenue,
new customers to local businesses, decarbonization in the face of climate crisis, but most
importantly it will reduce displacement of existing residents into homelessness or
carbon-heavy car commutes.

CaRLA is a 501(c)3 non-profit corporation whose mission includes advocating for increased
access to housing for Californians at all income levels, including low-income households.
Consistent with the general plan, the proposed development will provide badly needed
housing on a central corridor and encourage a mix of commercial and mixed-income
residential uses that support the City’s economy and delivery of public services. In addition,
the proposed development is located a quarter mile from the Westchester/Veterans Metro
Station, providing future residents with easy access to transit and an overall reduction in
vehicle miles traveled.

While no one project will solve the regional housing crisis, the proposed 939 West
Manchester Boulevard development is the kind of housing Inglewood needs to mitigate
displacement, provide shelter for its growing population, and arrest unsustainable housing
price appreciation. You may learn more about CaRLA at www.carlaef.org.
